content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early-to-mid forecast horizon, especially after sharp spikes.
- Overestimates in late forecast period (last 5–10 days) when true prices show mean reversion or downward correction.
- Forecasts tend to lag behind true price movements by 3–7 days, particularly after volatility spikes.
- When history shows strong upward momentum, model overreacts with excessive overshoot in short-term forecast.
- Model fails to capture mean reversion in high-volatility periods; true prices often revert to 30-day moving average faster than forecast suggests.
- Forecasts are overly conservative in low-volatility periods, missing upward momentum that follows.
- Model exhibits bias toward lower prices when recent history is trending down, and overestimates when trending up.
- Correction: Adjust forecast by +10% to +20% for periods with recent upward momentum, and -10% to -15% for downward trends, especially if volatility is high.
